title: LSD live capture protocol, version 0
description: The messages a capturing sender (a test run, a filter in a service) sends to LSD Studio over the WebSocket at /ws/captures, one JSON object per text frame, and the messages the server sends back. The first message from a sender is a hello. The version is semver: a server accepts a hello with the same major at any minor and refuses any other major. A minor only adds optional fields or message types, so a receiver ignores fields it does not know. Captured events are the report schema's DiagramEvent, so a live report has the same shape as a written one.

Version.description: Semver of the protocol the message follows. This schema is 0.1.0.

SenderMessage.description: A message from the sender, told apart by type.

Hello.description: The handshake, first and once. It names the protocol and its version, and the report the captures build.

title.description: The report's title. Absent: Live capture.

ScenarioStart.description: A scenario begins. Its id is the sender's and is unique within the report.

CapturedEvent.description: One captured interaction or other diagram row, in capture order, in a started scenario.

ScenarioEnd.description: A scenario finished, with its outcome.

ReportDone.description: The sender is finished. The server stores the report as it stands and closes the socket.

SenderError.description: Something went wrong on the sender's side, such as a capture that failed. The report keeps it as a fact; the stream goes on.

Welcome.description: The answer to an accepted hello: the protocol version the server speaks and where the live report is.

url.description: The report page's path on the server.

ServerError.description: A refused message. unsupported-version and hello-required close the socket (4001, 4002); the others leave it open and the message is ignored.

Stored.description: The answer to report.done, sent before the server closes the socket (1000).
